points: isCaddyfile("./Caddyfile.preview", "") → true：扩展名不是已注册适配器名的未知后缀按 Caddyfile 处理，不报 ambiguous 错误
isCaddyfile(".serve/Caddyfile.preview", "") → true：隐藏目录路径只取 basename 判断，结果与 ./Caddyfile.preview 一致
isCaddyfile("./Caddyfile.yaml", "") → false 且 err 非空：已知适配器扩展名仍报 ambiguous，保持原有行为
isCaddyfile("./Caddyfile.json", "") → false 且 err 为 nil：JSON 分支不受改动影响
isCaddyfile("./Caddyfile.PREVIEW", "") → true：扩展名大小写不敏感（沿用 ToLower），与小写结果一致
isCaddyfile("./Caddyfile.yaml", "caddyfile") 与 isCaddyfile("./Caddyfile.preview", "caddyfile") → 显式 adapter 优先，均返回 true 且无错误
